title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: The new angle campaigns started well, spending about 5.7k on day one at 0.9 NC ROAS, while the main campaign was cut from 35k to 30k and brain from about 8k to 6k at 0.56. The team will scale hard for Black Friday from Monday with hourly surf scaling, keeping NCPA near 110 and at most 120, and reset budgets to actual spend before midnight. Avia is still weak, so every congruent unlaunched video goes into its campaign with Black Friday statics, and budget rises only on performance.
points: Blood flow campaign split, a separate blood pressure campaign launched, and promising angles given their own campaigns
Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaign version two launched on a new structure; evergreen bottom-of-funnel campaign deferred until after Black Friday
Four to five new blood sugar videos added; prostate and neuropathy still have no new videos
Three AppLovin campaigns launched at 200 each with 16 videos and 10 end cards to the general PDP; quizzes and presales raised as possible better destinations
The partner tool that paused Avia ads was removed; rejected Meta ads must never be deleted
Avia top spenders performed poorly and the Avia campaign has no statics or bottom-of-funnel ads yet
Haskap Berry will launch on a new ad account with a 500 CBO, and Avia is moving to Shopify for retention
Ads without an explicit Black Friday offer in the call to action are not working this week
decisions: Scale aggressively Monday to Friday while NCPA stays near 110, with 120 as the maximum
Reactivate the cholesterol AppLovin campaign once its end cards are replaced
Put Black Friday assets in the existing Avia campaign and turn them off after Black Friday
Launch every Avia video that matches the general PDP; leave out mismatched angles such as testosterone
Raise budgets on performance, never on the number of videos
Give Haskap its own ClickUp folder and redirect old Checkout Champ links to Shopify after the Avia move
